name: JW Marriott Hotel Kuala Lumpur
positioning: JW Marriott hotel on Jalan Bukit Bintang in Kuala Lumpur's central business and entertainment district, with a Level 6 outdoor pool and poolside rooms
best_for: Travelers who want to be in the middle of Bukit Bintang's shopping, street food and nightlife
Families or groups who want a two-bedroom suite with ensuite bathrooms

facts.text: The hotel is on Jalan Bukit Bintang in Kuala Lumpur's central business and entertainment district.
The hotel is known as The Happening Hotel.
The Starhill houses maisons such as Louis Vuitton and Rolex alongside Asia's first Balmain boutique.
Bukit Bintang MRT Station and Bukit Bintang KL Monorail Station are nearby.
Jalan Alor street food is within walking distance of the hotel.
The gym's changing rooms have shower facilities, sauna and steam rooms.
JW Mezzanine is the hotel's co-working space, designed for creatives, innovators and entrepreneurs.
The Chairman Suite has a luxurious bedroom with a spacious ensuite, a grand living room and a private dining area.
The Junior Suite features a unique layout, plush bedding and a cozy daybed.
The Club Executive Room offers access to the JW Executive Lounge.
Luk Yu Tea House serves dim sum and classic Cantonese and Chaozhou specialties.
The Alchemy is an intimate bar and restaurant in white marble and gold that serves a New Yorker Afternoon Tea.

highlights.text: The Cabana Poolside Room is on Level 6 and offers direct access to the pool and recreational facilities.
The outdoor swimming pool is on Level 6, with sun loungers.
The Two-Bedroom Suite has a King bedroom and a Twin bedroom, each with an ensuite bathroom, plus a spacious living area.
The gym overlooks the Bukit Bintang district.

considerations.text: Rollaway beds are not permitted in the rooms.
The Executive Lounge is for guests aged 12 and older.
WhataHotel notes a busy urban location with high foot traffic.
